body.input: It's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There was just a lot of electric atmosphere in the room.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now things settle down a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But here's where things get interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre throws the whole tactical game out the window right from the start.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He goes for the take down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon doesn't try to fight the take down because it's in his interests to go to the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But I love this about Andre.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's literally like, fuck you kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Let's see how good your ground game is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he shoots the take down and Gordon accepts it obviously because it's to his advantage

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to accept it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But I love the fact that Andre was like, I'm not even going to try and stall this out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm just going to bang.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's like, okay, let's see what you got kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They say you're good on the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Let's see what you fucking got.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I love that about Andre.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Unfortunately, he's entered the hornet's nest now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What happened there real quick?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because that was very fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon immediately went into Ashigarami.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Not just any Ashigarami, but Ashigarami was holding both legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's an open guard and he scooted forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Oh wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's really nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he splits the legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he dominates the space between the knees.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So there's a guaranteed straight Ashigarami here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He split the knees against Andre Gauvold like effortlessly right there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So already Gordon's in his preferred domain now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's starting to off balance his opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's looking for a reaction to get heel exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He does get heel exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre does a good job of monitoring the feet to try and reduce the breaking pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But the brute fact is it's in Gordon's realm now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is where he has all the advantage.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the match is going to be 20 minutes in Gordon's realm.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's going to be a very, very tall order.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Was there a moment here, again, Gordon's on the legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Are you impressed that Andre was able to get out from this?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I would expect this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre's been preparing for this for two years.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And remember, Andre has gone against some of the greatest leg lockers in grappling before

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and prevailed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's not naive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He knows how to defend himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The big problem is that he's going to create defensive reactions, which lead into other

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: aspects of Gordon's game, in particular back exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So here, Ashigarami goes to a single leg type of position where Gordon runs to Andre's back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he has to return him to the mat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The most efficient way to do so is always courtesy of foot sweeping.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he pulls out a D'Ashiharae from the back to sweep him down to the mat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And now Gordon's on top.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And this is a serious problem for any grappler in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Once Gordon gets top position, he's just relentless.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But just getting Andre Gavard's good, just getting the guard back, all of that is great.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's also a sense here in which Gordon is pacing it too, just to physically fatigue

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: an opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's passing the guard, but not rushing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now what Gordon's looking for here is complete chest to chest contact.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's getting very close to it now.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And once he gets chest to chest on an opponent in top position, past one of his opponent's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: knees, it's going to be awfully, awfully difficult for an opponent to recover.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What is he waiting for here?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is there pressure here?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Over time, where is he at?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's part of a campaign of attrition, of pressure over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he's creating a situation where he's either going to get back exposure or mount exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And either way is pretty much fatal when you're dealing with Gordon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre elected to go the route of back exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now Gordon got the body triangle, is on his back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now there's one physical problem here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's Andre Galvin has a neck like a ball and he has a very short and very thick neck.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So penetrating under the chin for a strangle can be a real problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He also has extremely well developed shoulders and upper arms.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So when the head comes down and the shoulders go up, there's very little real estate to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: work with, with regards to your strangle holds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Gordon in time will trap one of his opponent's arms with his legs in order to take away one

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of those strong defensive arms.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There you can see the arm has been trapped and now he can start working towards the strangle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And now here is still difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's still difficult, but things are looking good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's still a considerable amount of time left on the clock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon is well ahead on points.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So all the pressure, all the tactical pressure now is on Andre.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You'll see the critical penetration of the jaw with the wrist.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now Gordon Alex for a one handed strangle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Andre fought very bravely, but a strangle, it doesn't matter how brave you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And where does the strangle actually happen in terms of, it felt like the strangles at

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the blade of the, it wasn't even fully sunk in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So where is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is that the full comers like a one handed?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a sense in which once you get underneath, you know, the inevitable follow up is coming.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Again, the inevitable, you're feeling the inevitable.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's like a, to go back to your chess analogy, it's like resigning in chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In chess it's considered almost like impolite to let it run out when you understand, when

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you understand that death is on the horizon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there's a lot of, there's a lot of respect.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That was the beautiful thing with all the trash talk and everything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Gordon always shows respect.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I love that about the drama of combat is trash talk in the beginning and respect at the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think it's, you know, when you, when you feel someone, Andre has great skills and when

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you, when you grapple someone, you feel just how skilled they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And it, whatever issues you had prior to the match evaporate when you, when you feel that,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: okay, they're just like you, they do the same moves and same kind of concepts.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And you see that there's more that bonds you together than separates you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that's the feeling at the end of most grappling matches.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So if we could talk about John Carlo who had an incredible performance and I mean, there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: a lot of things we can say, we can probably go through his matches, but if we could just

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: talk without that about some of the most impressive things that you saw about him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: One of the things I think you mentioned elsewhere in here is about confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So one of the things you saw that could really benefit him as an athlete and competitor is

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to build up his confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is there, can you speak to that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: First of all, I should give you some background.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: John Carlo Badoni was a strong local black belt in Boston teaching at Bonata Faria School.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When I would film instructional videos, I would often talk to him and talk to him about

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: his competitions and training and he would do local competitions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He was trying to go from gi training, which was the majority of his competitive background

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: into no gi.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he was struggling in local competitions, especially with things like leg locking where

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: he had no background in leg locking and would often get submitted.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So as we worked together in instructional videos, we would talk and discuss.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He would periodically come to the gym in New York City and come in to work out with the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: guys and he often struggled in the training room.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He had no experience with things like body lock guard passing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And this used to mean that many of the training sessions didn't go well for him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he was always like a very polite, well-spoken young man and worked hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When we went to Puerto Rico and the team ended up drifting apart, when we moved into Austin,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: he said, you know, now that many of your athletes have left, could I come down and train with

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you guys full time?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I was like, yeah, I'd love to.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I thought it'd be a great training partner for Gordon and Gary.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We didn't really have any training partners at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And sure enough, he literally just picked up everything he had and moved down to Austin.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now anyone who just moves halfway across the country to begin training, that already gets

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: my respect right there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's a big commitment.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he began training.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We put him on a training schedule where first he had to cover up his big weaknesses.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He had limited attacks from bottom position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He had poor leg lock defense and he was very, very vulnerable to certain kinds of guard

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: passing, which weren't part of his experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is this all a year out from AGCC?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I'll also maybe give the spoiler, which is he wins his division in a dominant fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He also does incredibly well at the absolute.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It was an amazing thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: To give you an idea, when he first moved to Austin, he competed in a WNO event and I don't

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: think he scored a single point, lost a couple of matches and including matches to people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: who were in this ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he came out of that looking very depressed and he lost to Ken Anduate, he lost to Mason

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Fowler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So John Carlyle always struck me as someone who was positionally sound.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He had good guard retention, things like this, but he had no offense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He had no leg lock defense and he just wasn't able to assert authority on matches.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He was a guy who was always going to be tough to beat because it was hard to pass his guard,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that kind of thing, but he wasn't dangerous.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Can I ask you a question on that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Because my interaction with him early on when he came to Austin, I remember he interacted

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with me a bunch on the mat showing me stuff, but I wonder if that kindness is a detriment

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to the confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Is there some connection?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Again, confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So killers can be nice too.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It comes from skill level and confidence is a much more rational thing than most people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: describe it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: People think of confidence as like this esoteric, ethereal element that you either have or you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: don't when in fact, confidence is much more a reflection, a rational reflection on your

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: past experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And if you're successful with your past experience and you're expecting to compete in a situation

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: which is similar to your past experience and that past experience has mostly been successful,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: you'll be confident.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Are you pretty confident that the sun will rise tomorrow?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Of course you are because it's done so every time in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now there's no, as people like Hume pointed out, there's no supreme rational reason for

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: believing this, but nonetheless, your confidence is high and it's the same thing in Jiu-Jitsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you're performing well and skills are the reason for that, your confidence will be high

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in the future regardless of what your mindset is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it's not a question of this personality does better in competition or that personality.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Ultimately, it's going to come down to your skills and your confidence will be a reflection

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of your accumulation of skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So what was this journey like to a person who lost to a person who dominated the competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: First things first, we had to say, okay, you've got an obvious weakness, leg lock defense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So every day in the gym, he would be taught, okay, this is where you put your feet.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is where you position your knees.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You point your knee this way, not this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Then he would have to start sparring situations in leg locks and have to work his way out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Initially, these were like heartbreaking sessions for him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I've got to give that kid full credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He just worked his way through it patiently, dealt with frustration, initial failures,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and just said, I'm going to get better.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Can we just look at that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So what's the experience of those early training sessions like from an athlete perspective?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's daunting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Are you basically dealing with the rational thought that you're not going to ever be good?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You're wondering, have I even got what it takes?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's an established player who's been in IBGF competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I believe he's a Brown Belt world champion in the Gi.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And suddenly a group of kids that he's never even seen before repeatedly submitting him

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: with leg locks in the gym.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he's like, man, this is terrible.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: A year from now, I'm supposed to fight ADCC against people like Craig Jones, some of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: best leg lockers in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It must have been hard, but he just stayed in there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And no one worked harder than him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He just was in the gym three times a day, studying every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And unlike so many other people, every time he was showing something, he consciously and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: deliberately tried to enact it, even at the price of initial failure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Do you advise that that's a good way to go?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's the only way to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Like if you can't wrap your head around the idea that trying to acquire new skills will

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: create a temporary time where your effectiveness diminishes as you're trying to bring on new

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: skills, you're never going to make it because you'll always stay at whatever skillset you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: are.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The whole mental trick is to imbue this idea of delayed gratification that you have to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: accept that when I bring on new moves, my overall effectiveness will diminish, but there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the belief that in time, as my skill performance increases, it will increase over time, but

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it will come at the price of initial frustration and failure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And John Carlo made that mental switch early on in his time in Austin, and to his credit,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: just stuck through.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Within a very short period of time, he became very hard to leg lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And even the best leg lockers in the room had a hard time with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that was the first step in confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He said, okay, I'm not getting finished quickly anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Then he had to bring in a whole new set of upper body submissions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He neglected upper body submissions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When you say upper body submissions, do you mean the arm locks?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Strangleholds, arm locks, things like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And in particular, he put very, very hard work on his strangleholds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He had always been someone who was positionally strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He could get to the back, but he could never finish from the back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then suddenly in the gym, he started finishing from the back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then as gym performance against the lesser students increased, then you bump them up

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: against better students.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then this goes on all the way up to the best guys in the room.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And in time, in a relatively short period of time, there were significant increases

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And success begets success, and this kept going.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: We started to get a hint of his developing confidence in local competitions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I remember seeing John Carlo compete in a local fight to win competition against a tough

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Brazilian kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: John Carlo just came out, dominated and finished with a leg lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now that was interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He said, okay, you're the guy that used to get finished by leg locks, and now you're

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: beating tough opponents with leg locks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that was an important psychological step for John Carlo Badoni.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And with each little step as we went further and further, then he got to ADCC trials and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: had one of the great performances.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I believe he submitted all of his opponents in ADCC trials and put on a fantastic display

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: of grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Shockingly, no one paid attention to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They were just like, oh yeah, he won.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And John Carlo flew into ADCC completely under the radar.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They just saw him as, oh, he's the guy that won American trials.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And no one really paid much attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In his first match, he took on a great Brazilian champion, Isake, and won in dominant fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He was about to strangle him with just a few seconds left on the clock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I remember John Carlo being furious at the end of the match, thinking like, I was

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: so close to finishing, he wanted a perfect finish.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And up on point, six to nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And still chasing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He could have just coasted at this point, but he wanted to finish every one of his opponents.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he got very, very close, but not quite there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then in his next match, he had to take on the defending gold medalist from the previous

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, Mateus Dinius.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This was the guy who was the favorite to win.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you have a relatively unknown John Carlo fighting the man who defeated Craig Jones

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in the previous ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Do you remember what stood out to you about this match?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So, Mateus Dinius is good wrestling, he's good at everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's a good all around grappler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: By judicious standards, he's a very strong wrestler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So our intention was to match his wrestling with John Carlo's judo skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you will see if we could perhaps go back, you'll see the first take down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Arm drag.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And took him down with a simple drag and pick.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that was John Carlo's first take down that was more wrestling oriented and good for his

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: confidence to see that he could score a nice take down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But Mateus Dinius is very, very good at standing up from bottom position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If we just go back to the stamp.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now here we have something interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's really nice.

body.input: Look at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Look at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But they are not strong in foot fighting.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so we put a very heavy emphasis on foot sweeping attacks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You remember Gordon Ryan took down Andre Galvin with a foot sweep.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: front.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And an overhook.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Lifting post.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Catches the foot mid-air.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Look at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that's just a beautiful, beautiful takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's beautiful judo.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then later in the match, you'll use a Kusaragake, another classical judo takedown

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to get top position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now at one point, John Carlo was in trouble.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he got his back exposed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: With this situation?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Double leg to a...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: To a knee pick.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Knee pick.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he has to expose his back in order to avoid giving up takedown points.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But here's a defensive training that we work on is coming through.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's defensively sound, shuts out the hook, prevents the score.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Use his body at the right angle to prevent a power half nelson.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Staying calm.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he's got to turn this around.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's one of the hardest things to do in grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: How dangerous is it to put your...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's ordinarily, it could be dangerous because your opponent could switch to an arm bar.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Whoops.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there's the body lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now there's some controversy here, but you can clearly see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The hands were locked.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So it shouldn't really be as controversial as people are saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now watch for the right leg Kosorogake here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Pulls in the hips, exposes the leg, boom, and down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Beautiful Kosorogake.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's why they say in combat sports, defend yourself at all times.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But now the great advantage of judo takedowns over wrestling leg tackles is they confer

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: upper body connection after the takedown, which is very, very important for ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's why we put such a heavy emphasis on them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And now John Carlos is absolutely in the driver's seat.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He just scored four points for that takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's well ahead at this point against the established favorite for the entire weight

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: division.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now Mateus Diniz has to start taking some risks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's staring down the barrel of defeat and there's not that much time left.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that's what's going to set up the pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now it's tactical pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's not physical pressure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's tactical.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Mateus has to turn away and that's going to create back exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The most dangerous kind of exposure in ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Oh, there it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So, mount to back and John Carlos capitalizes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Mateus is smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's keeping on his side so that less than 75% of his back is on the floor to deny the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: mount points.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But that comes at a price and that price is back exposure.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the thing we talked about with Gordon, the circumstance of fate, which is he has

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: a lot of grueling tough matches and still chooses to do absolute.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he seems to just power through all of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: How much of the calculation is how to survive the cardio, the grueling cardio aspect of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: all of this?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's a great question.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the truth of the matter is you can't afford to pace yourself because if you say, I'm going

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to hold myself back for this match and expectation of the others, you could end up losing your

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: first match.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he didn't pace himself at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Any of the matches.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You have to just be in good shape and that's what the campus is for.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: No it's mostly physical.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's what the campus for.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Like he's felt more pressure in the training room than he felt in any of his matches.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But still sort of attacking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Look at this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That was a beautiful transition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: From back or from whatever the heck that position was, right from looking for the back, transitioning

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What the heck is this transition?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So Matthias is engaging in a very good tactic, which is to get most of his back off the ground

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to deny them the mount points.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So as back exposure starts to turn in, but you can see what's happening here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: As the left foot goes under, it's going to create a beautiful triangle entry.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Right foot penetrates through underneath the neck and now he's locking a triangle, a Senkaku,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: but not just any triangle, a triangle with the figure four locked on the back of the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: opponent's head, which makes any kind of stacking defense very, very difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It makes it very, very hard for an opponent to pull away and creates a much tighter strangle

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: than average.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: As a result, it's a quick submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Beautifully done.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Still chasing the submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

body.input: With a minute left up on points.

body.input: Against the former champion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Against the former champion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's match number two.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now that's the first day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's Saturday.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So John Coller goes to sleep that night thinking, okay, I just beat a world champion in my first

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: match and almost submitted him and I just submitted the defending champion.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So of course he wakes up on Sunday morning feeling pretty damn good.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now there's an interesting twist here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent is a talented young Irishman who won European trials, I believe almost

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: entirely with leg locks and almost all of his major attacks in the tournament so far

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: have been leg locks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now bear in mind that a year ago, John Coller was losing to local blue belt competitors

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: via leg lock.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So in my mind, I'm thinking, okay, how's he going to handle this?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Will the leg lock training kick in and you'll see the result.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: John Coller is on top passing an open guard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you can see his legs away from any attacks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent Owen from Ireland is employing the same tactics that we made famous years

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The idea of sitting to butterfly guard and looking to untangle the legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's kind of playing that game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So John Coller is obviously used to this from training in the gym.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's doing a good job of preventing entanglement, controlling his opponent's shoelaces and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: moving out to an angle, which limits his opponent's entry options.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So hands on the shoelaces and angles is a good defense here.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's an initial defense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now his opponent wants to get underneath the center of gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So John Coller wants to get outside the line of his legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At some point your opponent is going to entangle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If he's determined to entangle, at some point it's going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So John Coller decides, okay, let's let it happen and let's see where his feet go and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: see how disciplined he is with his feet and the opponent is inverted.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Here does a good job getting behind John Coller's knee.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So now they're fully locked in.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So John Coller moves away to protect the heel, rotates out, controls the shoelace.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now at this point, the Irishman is starting to lose discipline with his own foot position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's so focused on his own attack that he's starting to get a little sloppy with his own

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: foot position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He's assuming, oh, I'm the guy who's attacking, so my opponent will be afraid of my leg locks

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What are the strengths and weaknesses of each approach?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And how do those different approaches apply depending on which weight class you're in?
