metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yes, strangleholds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So they specialize in those.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They adapted a game based around movement, which forces opponents not with physical pressure,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: but with tactical pressure into positions which expose them to those specialized strangleholds

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that they use.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Traditionally, when we looked at the Rua-Tolas when they were young, we saw that there was

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: a disparity between their top game and their bottom game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They were generally much better in top position than they were in bottom position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Again, they saw that as a potential weakness and they turned it around using, again, their

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: unique long limbs relative to their height.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They make use of a buggy strangle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm not sure why it's referred to as a buggy strangle, but basically it's a variation of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Katakatama using the legs done from disadvantageous positions on bottom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They both make brilliant use of that, not so much as a strangle weapon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Occasionally, they'll strangle someone, but they mostly use it to create pressure to make

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: people back off.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: As a result, they overcame the disparity between their top game and their bottom game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now their bottom game is part of their offense and they're very, very successful from there.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So again, you had that really impressive sense in which they identified their weaknesses

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and leg locks in bottom position, turned it around and made it into strengths.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: At the same time, they identified, okay, what are our physical gifts and how can we maximize

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: their use?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And they created a program of initiating movement that created tactical rather than physical

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: pressure to set up their best strangle holds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I deeply admire what they've done.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Two young men have a huge future ahead of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So here, one of the brothers faces in the absolute, Nicholas Murgally.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Bear in mind, Tai has just fought two very tough matches against guys bigger and stronger

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: than himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he's coming into a third match against a third guy who's also bigger than he is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So hats off to Tai fighting open weight against three monsters in a row.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now Tai and Cade, one of their best attributes is they are two of the best scramblers in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the sport of jiu-jitsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So whenever you go to shoot on the legs with them, there's a danger of running straight

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: into a dark strangle hold.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They're very competent at counterattacking single legs with dark strangles.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's also very hard to control them after a takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They do a very good job of springing back up to the feet.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So I told Nicholas to favor upper body judo based takedowns rather than wrestling takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And you see here a fine example of Nicholas's gathering skill in Uchimata, one of the great

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: throws of judo.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Set up with a, there's a bit of a foot sweep.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Like a...

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The nice thing is he starts off with what it looks like.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's actually a two-directional Uchimata.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He threatens Uchigari to the back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's a throw that throws your opponent to the back.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: His opponent pushes into him, then he changes direction with a support foot and takes him

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: over with Uchimata.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: As we said earlier, the great advantage of judo over wrestling is that because there's

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: upper body connection during the throw and after the throw, it's much harder for an opponent

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to scramble away from you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And even Tai Rua-Tolo is one of the best scramblers in the sport.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He has to stop scrambling here and just go back to guard position and enable Nicholas

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to hold top position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Some of it is also the surprise.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is something less understandable about judo techniques because there's less data,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: it feels like.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The Rua-Tolos also have a good Uchimata.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think they're very familiar with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: How often do you think are they on the receiving end of an Uchimata?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's a good point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I just feel like they have more data in terms of defending.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Of course, there is fundamentals to the Uchimata that make it difficult to scramble around.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This is a good example of someone who literally didn't have a single takedown six months ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now he's throwing one of the toughest guys in the sport with one of the more difficult

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: throws of judo.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now you're a judo man.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You'll back me up on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Uchimata is not an easy throw to learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Take some time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You're hopping on one foot with both of your body weight supported on one foot.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's very counterintuitive.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's one of the more difficult throws.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Let go of your understanding of takedowns, of maybe wrestling style takedowns or more

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: intuitive kind of takedowns to understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's many throws like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Uchigari is like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Sotogari is like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Uchimata is like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's weird.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm on one foot.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I'm hopping around.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This makes no sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Foot sweeps are also weird in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They're a little bit more intuitive, but to get very good at foot sweeps, you have to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: understand timing, weight distribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's a dynamic thing that's weird.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I always laugh when I talk to Nicholas and I say, I try to teach him a single leg, which

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: is traditionally most, like a high single leg is one of the easier takedowns to perform

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in terms of mechanical difficulty.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Nicholas always struggles with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Then I teach him one of the more difficult takedowns, Uchimata, and he does it flawlessly.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You never know.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Certain things get attached.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I mean, you see this in Judo, it's kind of interesting to see there's classes of takedowns

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and certain people just gravitate in their philosophical, intuitive understanding of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: body mechanics or something like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's like Sayanagya versus Uchimata.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You very clearly see there's some people that understand, they like to have both their feet

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: planted on the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And there's some people that are okay with this one foot on the ground and the other

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: one is doing something else.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And I think that, I don't know what that, what is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's what makes you fall in love with one field versus another.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So what can you speak to that, that you've released a new instructional on takedowns

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and standing skills for Jiu-Jitsu just at a high level using Nicholas as an example.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What are some key ideas about takedowns?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Okay, first, whenever people talk about standing position in Jiu-Jitsu, they always say, oh,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I need to learn some takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But it's never a question of just learning the takedowns, it's learning the prerequisites

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to the takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The takedowns are more or less like an afterthought.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You've got to begin with stance, motion, the ability to engage in grip and contact, get

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: your opponent out of balance and then comes the takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The takedowns in Jiu-Jitsu are mostly divided into lower body takedowns, tackles to the

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: legs, single legs, double legs, to a lesser degree, high crotch in Jiu-Jitsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And then upper body takedowns, which are mostly Judo derived.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Nicholas had to start more or less at the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I didn't even know how to come out and make grips or hold a stance.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he had to learn every element of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And the fact he was able to do so in six months was just incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Can you comment on the upward posture that seems to work for Jiu-Jitsu?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The matches in Jiu-Jitsu are much longer than the matches in wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In addition, there are many kinds of submission threat which are not there in wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the stance has to be significantly changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In wrestling, they favor generally a very low crouch because the vast majority of attacks

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: are tackles to the legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So anyone who stands upright in wrestling tends to get heavily punished by being taken

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: down immediately with a leg tackle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Jiu-Jitsu, the matches are so much longer, it would be difficult in a 40 minute match,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: for example, to maintain a bent over crouch, you'd be exhausted.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's also problems associated with submission holds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There are many forms of submission holds, guillotines, darts, etc., where if your head

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: comes down too low, you become a little vulnerable to this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so the stances in Jiu-Jitsu competition tend to be much more upright, more like Judo

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and Greco.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So right off the bat, you see the stance is different.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The motion tends to be much slower and more evenly paced because you've got to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to do this for long periods of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So the number of fakes per minute, the number of shots attempted per minute is usually much

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: slower.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So these are obvious differences.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The biggest difference, however, has nothing to do with that, it has to do with tactics.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Jiu-Jitsu, the scores will be judged by what happens after the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In the case of ADCC, you can take someone down in ways that would score in both wrestling

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and Judo and possibly even win the match in the case of Judo, and it would score zero

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: in ADCC because of the nature of the rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The whole idea of ADCC scoring is to demonstrate control after the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It's what happens in the critical three seconds after the takedown that creates the score.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Judo and in wrestling, the emphasis is based on the takedown itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Jiu-Jitsu, the emphasis is placed on the aftermath of the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's where the score is allocated.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That can be a period of up to three seconds.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now three seconds doesn't sound like much, but in a scramble after a takedown, three

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: seconds is a fucking eternity.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: It goes on forever.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So you will see many examples of takedowns that, as I said, would score very well in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Judo and wrestling, but don't score at all in ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so the whole skill becomes packaging the standing position in terms of the takedowns

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: themselves, but in particular, preparing the athletes for that critical three seconds after

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's why many people who are very fine wrestlers struggle in ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They take people down by wrestling metric all the time, but don't score under ADCC rules.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What makes GSB so good at takedowns?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I've gotten a chance to even recently watch him do takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Within this framework that you're teaching, what stands out to you about him that you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: draw lessons from?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Yeah, that's another example of someone who's performing takedowns in a rule set radically

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: different from wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Just as the ADCC rule set is so different from conventional wrestling rule sets, that

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the whole manner in which you approach takedowns and even your understanding of takedowns has

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to be quite strongly modified.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So to an MMA, it's even more extreme.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: People always think, oh, this guy's a good wrestler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He should be able to get takedowns in MMA easily.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What you find is that the wrestling skills in MMA enable you to finish takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you get in on your opponent and get to the legs or the waist or what have you, your

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: wrestling skill will enable you to finish the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But getting to the takedown is massively different in the context of MMA than it is in wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The entire stance is different.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The entire set of distancing is different.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's the idea of positioning within a cage, like how close you are to the perimeter of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the cage changes radically how you approach the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The setups are literally night and day different.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The setups are almost entirely composed of striking setups rather than grappling setups.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And so the act of getting to the takedown is like a completely different sport.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now, George studied wrestling and used to go to wrestling practice twice a week.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In Canada, they do freestyle wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They don't use the American college style of wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now George's main emphasis in wrestling training was takedowns.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Obviously the whole ground element of freestyle wrestling was of no interest to him.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Learning how to put people's back on the ground and turn them with leg laces and gut

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: wrenches was of no value in MMA.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he devoted almost all of his study to just the act of taking someone down.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So in pure wrestling, George is not bad, I think he would be a very competitive match

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: even for a highly ranked American freestyle wrestler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He would lose easily on the ground because he's not used to the par tier.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He'd probably be leg laced or gut wrenched quite easily by a skilled opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But in just a pure takedown battle, he'd be a competitive training partner for even a

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: good wrestler.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: But in actual MMA competition, he could take down even the most highly credentialed wrestlers

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and in some cases make it look almost effortless.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And that came from his unification of striking skill with wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So he used wrestling skills to finish the takedown and his karate and kickboxing pedigree

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: to enter into the takedown.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Now when he initiated the study of this, this was at a time when MMA was pretty much in

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: its infancy.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And he was one of the most impressive people I've ever seen in this regard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He was a true innovator.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He innovated this specialized area of striking to a takedown to a greater degree than anyone

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: else I'm aware of.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Well, let me ask you about this innovation because you're one of the most innovative

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: people in martial arts.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's several major categories of innovation that you have led.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Obviously, leg locks, body lock, now wrestling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What's your process of innovation?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So seeing the problems in a particular system, the gaps, how do you identify them and how

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: do you figure out systems of how to fill those gaps?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: First thing I look for is what are the current weaknesses in a given combat sport?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So in the case of jiu-jitsu, it was very obvious that historically jiu-jitsu had always been

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: weak in leg locking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Jiu-jitsu had always been weak in standing position overall.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And these were things that needed to be sorted out immediately.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: In its infancy, mixed martial arts was divided between grapplers and strikers.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: And most of the emphasis in early mixed martial arts was on the idea of specialists in a given

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: domain forcing the fight into their domain and that my early work with Georges Saint-Pierre

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: convinced me that the right approach wasn't increased specialization and learning to force

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: your athlete into that area of specialization at the expense of the opponent, but rather

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: the real battles of the future would be won and lost not with techniques per se, specialized

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: techniques, but rather the integration of techniques and the overlap between the various

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: grappling and striking skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So that someone who was an inferior grappler would have just enough grappling skills to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: be able to hold a grappler off and then defeat them with striking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: If you went to fight someone who's superior to you in striking, you would have just enough

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: striking skill to be able to hold them at bay and then enter into grappling.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: This went further and further until it got clear that there were whole areas of the sport

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: that you needed to change your entire mindset about them so that people went into early

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: MMA thinking in terms of grappler and striker.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: What I started to think is in terms of, okay, there are four fundamental skill areas of

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: mixed martial arts.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is shoot boxing, which is the integration of takedowns and striking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is clinch boxing, which is the integration of upper body clinch skills combined with

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: striking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is fence boxing, which the two athletes are locked up with each other on the fence

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and they have to integrate takedown, takedown defense and striking skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There is grapple boxing, which is the merging of ground grappling with striking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When you broke MMA down into those four categories, you saw that each one of those four domains

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: transcends the specialized martial arts that form their components.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: For example, in clinch boxing, you would incorporate things from judo, Greco-Roman freestyle, juditsu

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: submissions, Muay Thai, clinching techniques.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Even if you took all five of those, the rule set that you're operating in requires such

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: extensive modification that the final product of clinch boxing transcended all five of its

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: component martial arts and became its own autonomous skill, needed to be worked autonomously.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: When we broke George's training down into those four areas, that's when real progress

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: started to be made.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: That's when you started to see the integration of those four phases and the striking and

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: grappling within each of them was where victory was being won and lost.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Once you reframe how you see a particular combat sport, then you can start doing these

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: detailed development of ideas that actually fit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: There's a sense in which it had to start with a paradigm shift and then a research program

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: began after that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You don't start with research, you started with a paradigm shift and then went to research.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: Well, let me ask you, I got a chance to hang out with you and Hanzo Gracie at ADCC.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: He keeps messaging me saying he's going to call me and not calling me.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: I think aside from being hilarious, charismatic and handsome, and wise for his young age,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: he's also one of the greatest coaches and athletes of all time in martial arts.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: So let me ask, what have you learned about life from Hanzo Gracie?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The degree of difficulty that Hanzo must have encountered, he never talked to us about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: but I figured this out as the years went by.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: The degree of difficulty that he must have experienced when he first came to Manhattan

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: and started teaching, it must have just been incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: You've got to remember Hanzo came from Brazil training with the best people in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: at that time, Hickson, all the Machados.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: All of them were located around Gracie Baja and that Rio de Janeiro set.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They all knew each other and they all trained together.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, ADCC, and Animal Combat | Lex Fridman Podcast #328

body.input: They had internal problems of course, but they all knew each other well and knew each
