metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: as there being a subject of experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So you and I and everybody listening to this

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: is a subject of experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: There is a conscious subject who is taking things in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: responding to it in various ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: feeling good about it, feeling bad about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And that's different from the kinds

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: of artificial intelligence we have now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I take out my phone, I ask Google directions

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to where I'm going, Google gives me the directions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and I choose to take a different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Google doesn't care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: It's not like I'm offending Google or anything like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: There is no subject of experiences there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And I think that's the indication that

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Google, the AI we have now is not conscious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: or at least that level of AI is not conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And that's the way to think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Now, it may be difficult to tell, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: whether a certain AI is or isn't conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: It may mimic consciousness, and we can't tell

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: if it's only mimicking it or if it's the real thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: But that's what we're looking for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Is there a subject of experience,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: a perspective on the world from which things can go well

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: or badly from that perspective?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So our idea of what suffering looks like

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: comes from just watching ourselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: when we're in pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Or when we're experiencing pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: It's not only pleasure and pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Yes, so, and then you could actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: you could push back on this, but I would say

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that's how we kind of build an intuition about animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: is we can infer the similarities between humans and animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and so infer that they're suffering or not

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: based on certain things, and they're conscious or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So what if robots, you mentioned Google Maps,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and I've done this experiment, so I work in robotics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: with different speech interaction, voice-based interaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And if the Roomba or the robot or Google Maps

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: shows any signs of pain, like screaming or moaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: or being displeased by something you've done,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that, in my mind, I can't help but immediately upgrade it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And even when I myself programmed it in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: just having another entity that's now, for the moment,

body.input: makes me feel like it is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Like I immediately, then the whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: but that feeling is there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So sort of, I guess, what do you think about a world

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to realize they're not, or whatever, or that is conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: They appear to be conscious, and so you then have

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to give them rights.

body.input: The reason I'm asking that is that kind of capability

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: may be closer than we realize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Yes, that kind of capability may be closer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: but I don't think it follows that we have to give them rights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I suppose the argument for saying that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: in those circumstances, we should give them rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: is that if we don't, we'll harden ourselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: against other beings who are not robots

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and who really do suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: That's a possibility that, if we get used to looking

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: at a being suffering and saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: yeah, we don't have to do anything about that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that being doesn't have any rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: maybe we'll feel the same about animals, for instance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And interestingly, among philosophers and thinkers

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: who denied that we have any direct duties to animals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and this includes people like Thomas Aquinas

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and Immanuel Kant, they did say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: yes, but still it's better not to be cruel to them,

body.input: not because of the suffering we're inflicting

body.input: we may develop a cruel disposition,

body.input: and this will be bad for humans,

body.input: because we're more likely to be cruel to other humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: But you don't accept that kind of...

body.input: I don't accept that as the basis of the argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: for why we shouldn't be cruel to animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and the suffering is a bad thing.

body.input: if it's gonna be harder for us to distinguish.

body.input: But at the risk of sounding crazy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Where you would start getting uncomfortable

body.input: Or alternatively, whether you're in a situation

body.input: And so it's quite possible that actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: most of the community is really excited about now

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: is with learning methods, so machine learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And the learning methods are unfortunately

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: not capable of revealing, which is why somebody

body.input: like Noam Chomsky criticized the idea of artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: He criticizes them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: You've created powerful systems that are able

body.input: And so it's possible if those are the kinds

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: is conscious or not, this thing is intelligent or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: where in the billions of nodes, neurons

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: in this artificial neural network is the fear coming from?

body.input: So if in that case, that's a really interesting place

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: where we do now start to return to behaviorism and say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Yeah, that is an interesting issue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I would say that if we have serious doubts

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and think it might be conscious, then we ought to try

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to give it the benefit of the doubt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: just as I would say with animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I think we can be highly confident

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that vertebrates are conscious, but when we get down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and some invertebrates like the octopus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: but with insects, it's much harder to be confident of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I think we should give them the benefit of the doubt

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: where we can, which means, I think it would be wrong

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to torture an insect, but this doesn't necessarily mean

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and stop you getting to sleep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So I think you try to achieve some balance

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: in these circumstances of uncertainty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: If it's okay with you, if we can go back just briefly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So 44 years ago, like you mentioned, 40 plus years ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: you've written Animal Liberation, the classic book

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that started, that launched, it was the foundation

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: of the movement of animal liberation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Can you summarize the key set of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that underpin that book?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Certainly, the key idea that underlies that book

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: is the concept of speciesism, which I did not invent

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that term, I took it from a man called Richard Ryder,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: who was in Oxford when I was, and I saw a pamphlet

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that he'd written about experiments on chimpanzees

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that used that term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: But I think I contributed to making it philosophically

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: more precise and to getting it into a broader audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And the idea is that we have a bias or a prejudice

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: against taking seriously the interests of beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: who are not members of our species, just as in the past,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Europeans, for example, had a bias against taking seriously

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: the interests of Africans, racism, and men have had a bias

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: against taking seriously the interests of women, sexism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So I think something analogous, not completely identical,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: but something analogous goes on and has gone on

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: for a very long time with the way humans see themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: vis-a-vis animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: We see ourselves as more important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: We see animals as existing to serve our needs

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: in various ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And you can find this very explicit in earlier philosophers

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: from Aristotle through to Kant and others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And either we don't need to take their interests

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: into account at all, or we can discount it

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: because they're not humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: They can a little bit, but they don't count nearly

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: as much as humans do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: My book argues that that attitude is responsible

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: for a lot of the things that we do to animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that are wrong, confining them indoors

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: in very crowded, cramped conditions in factory farms

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to produce meat or eggs or milk more cheaply,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: using them in some research that's by no means essential

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: for our survival or wellbeing, and a whole lot,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: some of the sports and things that we do to animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So I think that's unjustified because I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: the significance of pain and suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: does not depend on the species of the being

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: who is in pain or suffering any more than it depends

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: on the race or sex of the being

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: who is in pain or suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And I think we ought to rethink our treatment of animals

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: along the lines of saying, if the pain is just as great

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: in an animal, then it's just as bad

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that it happens as if it were a human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Maybe if I could ask, I apologize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Hopefully it's not a ridiculous question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: but so as far as we know, we cannot communicate

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: with animals through natural language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: but we would be able to communicate with robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So I'm returning to sort of a small parallel

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: between perhaps animals and the future of AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: If we do create an AGI system or as we approach creating

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: that AGI system, what kind of questions would you ask her

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to try to intuit whether there is consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: or more importantly, whether there's capacity to suffer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I might ask the AGI what she was feeling to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: well, does she have feelings?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And if she says yes to describe those feelings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to describe what they were like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: to see what the phenomenal account

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: of consciousness is like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: But the question is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: what is consciousness is like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: That's one question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I might also try to find out if the AGI has a sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: of itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So for example, the idea, would you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: we often ask people, so suppose you were in a car accident

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And most people say, I think I would,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and so on, I would survive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Get at that sort of concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I think the meaning of life is the meaning we give to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I don't think that we were brought into the universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: I think we can recognize that some things

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and other things are objectively good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: like having a rich, fulfilling, enjoyable, pleasurable life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: And we can try to do our part in reducing the bad things

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and increasing the good things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: So one way, the meaning is to do a little bit more

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: of the good things, objectively good things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: and a little bit less of the bad things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Singer: Suffering in Humans, Animals, and AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #107

body.input: Throughout his career of research, including with Jürgen Schmidt Huber and Shane Legge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: he has proposed a lot of interesting ideas in and around the field of artificial general intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: that incorporates ideas of Kolmogorov complexity, Solomonov induction, and reinforcement learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: In 2006, Marcus launched the 50,000 euro Hutter prize for lossless compression of human knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: The idea behind this prize is that the ability to compress well is closely related to intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: This, to me, is a profound idea. Specifically, if you can compress the first 100 megabytes

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: or one gigabyte of Wikipedia better than your predecessors, your compressor likely has to also

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: be smarter. The intention of this prize is to encourage the development of intelligent

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: compressors as a path to AGI. In conjunction with his podcast release just a few days ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: Marcus announced a 10x increase in several aspects of this prize, including the money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: to 500,000 euros. The better your compressor works relative to the previous winners,

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

body.input: the higher fraction of that prize money is awarded to you. You can learn more about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75

metadata.title: Podcast: Marcus Hutter: Universal Artificial Intelligence, AIXI, and AGI | Lex Fridman Podcast #75
