body.input: And now, here's my conversation with Sarah Seeger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: When did you first fall in love with the Stars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I think I've always loved the Stars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: One of my first memory is of the moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I remember watching the moon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: and I was in the car with my dad,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: who my parents were divorced,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: and he was driving me and my siblings

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: to his house for the weekend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And the moon was just following me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: Just had no idea why that was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: Yeah, so like looking up at the sky,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: and there's this glowing thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: How do you make sense of the moon at that age?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: At that age, at like age five, there's just no way you can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I think it's one of the great things about being a kid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: is just that curiosity that all kids have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: You know, I was thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: because there's these almost out there ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: of that our Earth is flat, floating about on the internet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And it made me think, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: when did I first realize that the Earth is like this ball

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: that's flying through empty space?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I mean, it's terrifying, it's awe-inspiring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I don't know how to make sense of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: It's hard, because we live in our frame of reference

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: here on this planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: It's nearly impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: None of us are lucky to go to see the curvature of Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I mean, do you remember when you realized,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: understood like the physics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: like the layout of the solar system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: Did you first have to take physics to really,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: like high school physics to really take that in?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I think it's hard to say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I had this book when I was a child.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: It was in French.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I grew up in Canada,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: where French is supposedly taught to all of us

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: English speaking Canadians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And it was this book in French,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: it was about the solar system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I just loved flipping through it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: It's hard to say how much you or I understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: when we're kids, but it was really great book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: What about the stars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: When did you first learn about the stars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I do have this very incredible distinctive memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And again, it had to do with my dad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: He took us camping.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: Now my dad was from the UK,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: and he was the type who you'd find wearing a tie on weekends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: So camping was not in his fear, it was his comfort zone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: We had a babysitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: Every summer we got a babysitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: Every summer we had a babysitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And one summer we had Tom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: He was barely older than we were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: He was 14, my brother was 12.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: I would have been 11 or 10 maybe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And we went camping,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: because Tom said camping's the thing, we should try it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: And I just remember, I didn't aim to see the stars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: but I walked out of my tent in the middle of the night,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sara Seager: Search for Planets and Life Outside Our Solar System | Lex Fridman Podcast #116

body.input: That sacrifice, that gift enabled the West to rediscover itself, to rediscover its power, to revive itself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: to say, the hell with this energy dependence in the long term, the hell with this money laundering and reputation laundering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: the hell with this running back and forth to Moscow to try to see what Putin needs in order for him to feel respected, what appeasement he needs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So we'll see if it endures, but this shift comes from the Ukrainians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so it's no longer getting away with murder, Lex, and we thank the Ukrainians for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The people and the leadership and the separate factions that make up Ukraine uniting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: it's the unification, the uniting against the common enemy, standing up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: before anyone knew that they would be backed by all of these other nations, by this money and all this kind of stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: standing there, especially with the president Zelensky, where it makes total sense to flee, he stood his ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Let's take that point that you just raised, which is a deep and fundamental point, and I thank you for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Do you guys hear that? I think that was a compliment. There we go. Let's go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So, let's hear unification. I'm sitting here in front of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's an honor. And it's a mutual honor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So, Ukraine before the war is run by a TV production company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You're one guy running this fantastic, incredible podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There's 20 guys or so running a country the size of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And one's a producer and one's like a makeup person and one's a video editor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they're fantastically talented people if your country is a TV production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So, before the war, Zelensky had what, 25% approval rating, and he couldn't get much done, and it wasn't working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He got elected with 73%, as you know, and then he was down to 20. That's a pretty big drop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so, you're thinking maybe having a major, large-sized, 40 million-plus population European country run by a TV production company is not the best choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And then what do we see? We see President Zelensky decides to risk his life on behalf of his country, Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He decides to stay in the capital. He's not going to flee. They're going to stay and fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And he could be killed. He can die. It's a decision where he put his life on the line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Obviously, he's Jewish descent, Russian-speaking childhood and upbringing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Russian-speaking Jewish descent puts his life on the line for the country of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's a pretty big message, don't you think? And it's crucial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it turns out, not only that, Lex, but they're good at TV. They're good at information war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And in a war, it's a TV production company and a TV personality. That's exactly what you want running a country, because they're crushing in the information war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And he's spectacular. European Parliament, US Congress, Israeli Parliament. There's no room on Zoom, let alone in person, that he can't win over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He's just so effective. You know, this is the first time reality TV has been about reality instead of fake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Reality TV is just this completely fake nonsense. But Zelensky, this is real reality TV.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And he means it. And the nation is behind him. And they're just as courageous and just as ingenious in many ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it's spectacular. And so, yeah, who saw that coming? I didn't see that coming, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: In fact, the Biden... We talk about Putin's miscalculation. The Biden administration, as you alluded to, offered him an exit from the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They didn't say, you know, you want to stand and fight, we'll back you. They said, we'll get you out. You want to come now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And famously, you know that quote, right? What he said about how he doesn't need a ride. Remember that moment?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The Biden administration was poised to do another Afghanistan moment. That ignominious exit from Afghanistan was almost what happened in Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: when the Biden administration offered him that ride out of there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And fortunately, he declined and helped rally. And the people from below also rallied to stop the invader without the presidency and without the government in Ukraine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: saving the Biden administration and the European leaders who latched on. Fortunately, they had the presence of mind to latch on to this gift,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: this bravery and ingeniousness of Zelensky and the rest of the Ukrainians, and flipped and decided to support Ukraine's resistance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You know, first with 5,000 helmets only, as the Germans initially promised, and now with really heavy weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so that's something that wasn't foreseen. I certainly didn't foresee that. I foresaw the Ukrainian society being courageous and resisting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but I didn't foresee a television production company being exactly what you want to run a country in a war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: a president Zelensky willing to sacrifice, lay down his life and rallying others in the country to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And then the country being so effective, not just at courage, but at battlefield resistance to the Russian invasion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So I stand corrected by the Ukrainians, and I'm ecstatic that I was proven wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And like I said, there's clear factions of the West and the East of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And here's a person that, like you said, was in the high 20s, low 30s percentage approval in the country before the war, and now was able to use in the 90s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He's in the 90% approval rating. I mean, I think they stopped doing the polling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Once he hit 91% or whatever it was in the previous poll, I think they all understood that for now they didn't need any more polling,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that it's pretty clear the nation. So 25% to 90-something percent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And just like the 25% was deserved, the 90-something percent is also deserved, fully deserved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And the question is how that all stabilizes. It feels like this set of events, I may be paying attention to Twitter too much,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: which is a concern of mine, whether the change I see is just surface level or deep level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But it seems like we're in a new world. There's something dramatic has shifted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That this power that's rooted, I mean, in your study of the 20th century, it's so deeply rooted in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There's this power center of the world is now going to, has been shaken by this event.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And how that changes the world is unclear. It's unclear what lesson China learns from watching this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: what lesson India learns from watching this. Both nations, as far as you can get polls about Chinese population,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but both nations are largely in support of Putin. So Russia, India, and China are still supporting of Putin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Quietly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I would maybe elaborate a little bit on that point, Lex. I think you're right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The feeling that we're in an inflection moment, an inflection point, I think that's widespread.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And I think it's widespread for good reason. We might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But I also share your, let's say, modesty about where it's going and how hard it is to predict where this might go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's only an inflection point if the trends continue, right? If the trends endure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There are plenty of non-inflection points. After 9-11, the whole world rallied around the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: After it was attacked. After the bombing of the towers here in New York City and the hitting of the Pentagon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And that didn't last. It was not really an inflection point, was it? It felt like it might be, but it wasn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so this is not a comparable moment in terms of what happened, but it has the feeling that it might be a watershed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And maybe we'll squander it the way we squandered the post-9-11 rallying around the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Maybe we'll actually consolidate it and it'll endure, or maybe it'll endure despite ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And we can't tell and we can't know yet. And it depends in part on what we do and what we don't do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But here's a few things that we understand already.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The idea that the West was in decline and that the rest of the world had risen and was more powerful and that we lived in a multipolar world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that turns out to be empirically false. It's not true. I mean, it's just factually not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There are no major important multinational institutions, organizations that are run on behalf of or led by a South African, a Nigerian person from India.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Even the Chinese don't run these institutions. They would like to and they're trying, but they don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so whatever you pick, the IMF, the World Bank, the Federal Reserve, which is the most powerful multinational institution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: which is actually only a domestic institution and doesn't have a legal mandate to act multilaterally, but does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's got the most power of any institution in the world. NATO, the bilateral alliances that the US has up and down Asia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What organizations that have tremendous leverage on the international system, on the international order, are non-Western?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The UN is the most encompassing. And of course, we know that it has five members of the Security Council with a veto,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: one of which is Russia, one of which is China, and the others are the US, Britain and France, not India, not South Africa, not Indonesia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: not all of these other countries where the people live, right? The bulk of the population of the world and where the population is growing like on the African continent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So it's not a multipolar world. We talked already about the international financial system. That's the Western, not multipolar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We talked about the US military in NATO, or we could talk about the Japanese military, which is just very formidable, enormous number of platforms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Even the Australian military, we could talk about, right? And so it's a Western dominated world. And the West, remember, is not a geographic concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It is an institutional and values club. The Japanese are not European, but they're Western, just like Russia is European, but not Western,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because European is a cultural category and Western is an institutional category where you have rule of law and separation of powers and free and open public sphere and dynamic open market economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Okay. And then we have another thing which is pretty clear. The West is powerfully resented, powerfully envied and admired simultaneously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: PJ O'Rourke, the comedian who died this year, fantastic. It was a big loss for the culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He said there are two things that are always characteristic of any American embassy abroad. One is a political protest outside, and the other is the longest line you've ever seen for visas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And those things are true simultaneously. And that's the world we live in, meaning that non-Western countries envy and admire the West, but they also resent the power of the West.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Western hypocrisy, right? The West invades countries when it wants, but when others do that, it's illegal, right? The West arrests you for money laundering, but it's Western money laundering that is where you go when you need to launder money, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So they see the hypocrisy, they see the excessive power that the West has, and they resent it. And they say, who elected you to run the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We have a billion plus people, or we have 200 plus million people, and we don't have a say. You're the self-appointed guardians of our world. Who did that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so it's incumbent on the West not only to remember the power that it has, but also to exercise that power legally and with restraint, and also to think about how we can expand institutions to be more encompassing so that other parts of the world are not on the outside being dictated to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but instead are on the inside. Too often, right, Western power is not consultative in a decision-making fashion. It's consultative after the fact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Okay, you know, we got together in the EU, or we got together in NATO, or we got together at the Federal Reserve, and here's our decision, and we're announcing it today. And so your economy gets destroyed because the Federal Reserve decides it has to raise interest rates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Or you now go into default. You can't pay your debt because Western banks lent you money, and now the West has changed interest rates or other considerations, and you're in big trouble now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so this is something which we fail to address. It's very hard to address. It's very hard to reform international institutions. It's very hard to share power. It's very hard to acknowledge that you have too much power and that maybe having too much power is not good, not only for the rest of the world, but for yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so it's great to rediscover the West and rediscover its values and rediscover its authority and credibility and power, but that's not sufficient. So we know this now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We know that the rest of the world is not necessarily jumping on the Western bandwagon to condemn Russia for its actions because the West can do things like sanction your central bank, take away your reserves, deny you technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It pretty much can do whatever it wants, and it can say that it's legal and it can go through various mechanisms and it can freeze your property, and you say to yourself, should anybody have that much power and when do they come after me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Now there's a caveat here, and the caveat Lex is they don't like the West having all of that power and they didn't join in the condemnation of Russia, but they also didn't join in Russia's aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So Russia's domestic civilian aerospace, aircraft industry, civilian aircraft industry is in big trouble now because of the export controls on spare parts and software.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Brazil is a major power in aircraft manufacturing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Did they rush in and say, you know, Vladimir Putin, we didn't condemn necessarily your actions in Ukraine, okay, that's one thing, and how about we give you all of our aircraft technology and we help you rebuild your domestic aircraft industry, and you can have the aviation that the West is, did that happen Lex?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Didn't happen. And you can look at India, and you can look at China, and you can look at South Africa, and you can look at what they've done in practical terms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Yes, they haven't always joined in a full-throated condemnation, maybe they've been neutral or maybe they've been playing both sides of the fence like Turkey, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But are they rushing in to join Russia, to join Russia's aggression, to supply, and the answer is no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And the answer is no for two reasons. One, they actually don't want to be party to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And two, they understand that Western power and they don't want to be on the receiving end by crossing the West and then getting caught up in a sanctions regime or worse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Can we go to the mind of Vladimir Putin because what you just said, China, India, they seem to sit back and say, we're not going to condemn the actions of Vladimir Putin and Russia, but we would really like for this war to be over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So there's that kind of energy of, we don't just stop this because you're putting us in a very, very bad position. And yet, Vladimir Putin is continuing the aggression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What is he thinking? What information is he getting? Is it the system that you've described of authoritarian regimes that corrupts your flow of information, your ability to make clearheaded decisions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Just as a human being, when you go to sleep at night, is he not able to see the world clearly or is this all deliberate, systematic action that does have some reason behind it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We've got to talk a little bit about China too, but let's answer your Putin question directly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So on Twitter, you've lost the war. Or as they say, there are these two Russian soldiers having a smoke in Warsaw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they're taking a break having a smoke and they're sitting there in Warsaw on top of their tank and one says to the other, yeah, we lost the information war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And there they are sitting in Warsaw having that smoke.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So yeah, on Twitter, Russia has completely lost the war. In reality, they failed to take Kiev, they failed to capture Kiev, and they failed in phase two, as they called it, or plan B, which is to capture the entirety of the Donbas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We're three months into the war. If you had made a judgment about, let's say, the Nazi invasion of the Soviet Union, a definitive judgment after three months, you might have got the outcome wrong there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: If you had judged the Winter War, the 1939-40 Soviet invasion of Finland, after three months, you would have got that wrong too of what the outcome was going to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So we're early in the game here and we have to be careful about any definitive judgments. But it is the case that so far they failed to take Kiev and they failed to capture the entirety of the Donbas, Luhansk and Donetsk provinces, eastern Ukraine, a part of eastern Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they've been driven out of Kharkiv and the area immediately surrounding Kharkiv. They never captured Kharkiv, but they came close, but now the Ukrainians drove them back to the Russian border in that very large and important region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So those look like battlefield losses that are impossible to explain away if you're the regime in Russia, except by suppression of information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And as you know from Russian history, like leaders in Russia have an easier time with a state of siege and deprivation than they do with explaining a lost war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But let's look at some other facts that are important to take into account.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: One, the Russian army has penetrated farther into Ukrainian territory since February 2022, including in Kherson region, the famous Mariupol siege that just ended.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They have built a large presence in areas north of Crimea on the Sea of Azov, the Black Sea, Latoral, ultimately, that they didn't previously hold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're still fighting in Luhansk for full control over at least half of the Donbas, and Ukrainians are resisting fiercely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But nonetheless, you can say that they've been driven out, on the contrary, farther penetration than the beginning. Ukraine doesn't have an economy anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They have somewhere between 33 and 50 percent unemployment. It's hard to measure unemployment in a war economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But their metallurgical industry, that Azov-style steel plant in Mariupol, is a ruin now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And a lot of farmers are not planting the fields because the harvest from the previous year still hasn't been sent, sold abroad because the ports are blockaded or destroyed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so you don't have an economy, and you need five billion or seven billion or eight billion dollars a month to meet your payroll, to feed your people, to keep your army in the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's a lot of money per month, and that's indefinite. That's as long as this blockade lasts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so you don't have an economy anymore. You're indigent. And even if you take the lower number, five billion, as opposed to Zelensky's ask for seven billion, five billion is 60 billion a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's 60 billion this year. That's 60 billion next year. And so who's got that kind of money? Which Western taxpayers are ready?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And if you use the seven or eight billion, you get up to 100 billion a year. The Biden just signed, President Joe Biden just signed the bill, making it law, $40 billion in aid to Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's just an enormous sum. The economic piece of that is a month and a half, two months of Ukrainians covering Ukrainian expenditures. That's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they're asking the G7, they're asking everybody for this. So you have no economy and no prospect of an economy until you evict the Russians from your territory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And then you have a Western unity, Western resolve. It lasts or it doesn't last, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So you're President Putin and you've got more territory than before. And you've got a stranglehold over the Ukrainian economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you've got a lot of the world neutral and you've got the Chinese propaganda supporting you to the hilt with those Oliver Stone and Mearsheimer lines about how this is really NATO's fault.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you've got Hungary dragging its feet on the oil embargo against Russia and you got Turkey dragging its feet on the recent applications of Sweden and Finland for NATO expanse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you're saying to yourself, Lex, maybe I can ride this out. I got a lot of problems of my own and we can go into the details on the Russian side, the challenges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But he's got, he's on Ukrainian territory unless he's evicted. And he's got a stranglehold on their economy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And he's got the possibility that the West doesn't stay resolved and doesn't continue to pay for Ukraine's economy or supply those heavy weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so you could argue that maybe he's deluded about all of this and maybe he should go on Twitter. I'm not on Twitter, but maybe Putin, who famously doesn't use the Internet, should go on Twitter and cease losing the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Or you can argue that maybe he's calculating here that he's got a chance to still prevail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Wow, that is darkly insightful. If I could go to Henry Kissinger for a brief moment and people should read this op-ed he wrote in the Washington Post in March 5th, 2014, after the start of the war between Russia and Ukraine, but before Crimea was annexed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There's a lot of interesting historical description about the division within Ukraine, the corruption within Ukraine that will, if people read this article, give context to how incredible it is, what Zelensky was able to accomplish in uniting the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I just want to comment, because Henry Kissinger is an interesting figure in American history. He opens the article with, in my life, I have seen four wars begun with great enthusiasm and public support, all of which we did not know how to end and from three of which we withdrew unilaterally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The test of policy is how it ends, not how it begins. So he's giving this cold hard truth that we go into wars excited, are able to send $40 billion, financial aid, military aid, our own men and women, but the excitement fades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Twitter outrage fades and then a country that's willing to wait patiently is willing to pay the cost of siege versus the cost of explaining to its own people that the war is lost, that country just might win, outlast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Let's hope not, because the Ukrainians resistance deserves to prevail here. Russia deserves to lose. No war of aggression like they've committed here against Ukraine should prevail if we can do anything about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I support a thousand percent the continued supply of heavy weapons, including offensive weapons to the Ukrainians, as long as they're willing to resist and it's their choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's their choice when to negotiate. It's their choice how much to resist. It's their choice what kind of sacrifices to make. And it's our responsibility to meet their requests more quickly than we have so far and at greater scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But ultimately wars only have political ends. They never have military ends. You need a political solution here. So if the Ukrainians are able to conduct a successful counteroffensive at scale in July or August whenever they launch, right now the heavy weapons are coming in and they're being moved to the battlefield and more are coming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You know the dynamic. Russia bombs a school. Russia bombs a hospital. Americans and Europeans decide to send even more heavy weapons to Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's the self-defeating dynamic from the Russian side. They commit the atrocities. We send more heavy weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Once those heavy weapons are on the battle lines, we'll see if Ukrainians cannot just defend, which they've proven they're able to do in breathtaking fashion, not just conduct counterattacks where the enemy moves forward and you cut behind the enemy's lines and you counterattack and push the enemy back a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But whether you can evict the Russians from your territory with a combined arms operation where you have a massive superiority in infantry and heavy weapons, but more importantly you coordinate your air power, your tanks, your drones, your infantry at scale, which is something the Ukrainians have not done yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's something the Russians failed at in Ukraine and they come from the same place, the Soviet military.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We hope this Ukrainian counter offensive at scale, this combined arms operation, succeeds and if it does succeed there's the possibility of a battlefield victory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Whether that also includes Crimea, which as you know is not hostile on the contrary to the Russian military, remains to be seen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But however much they regain territorially back towards the 1991 borders, which is their goal, their stated goal, and which we support them properly in trying to achieve, however much they achieve of that in this counter offensive that we're anticipating, that will set the stage for the next phase.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And either Russia, which is to say one person, Vladimir Putin, will acknowledge that he's lost the war because the Ukrainians won it on the battlefield, or he'll try to announce a full scale mobilization, conscript the whole country, go back and instead of acknowledging defeat, try to win with a different plan, recalibrate, remains to be seen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Will the Ukrainians negotiate any territory away or must they capture also Crimea, which puts a very high bar on the summer counter offensive that we're going to see, which could last through the fall and into the winter as a result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We don't know the answers to that. Nobody knows the answers to that. People are guessing. Some people are better informed because they have inside intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: People are also worried about Russian escalation to nuclear weapons or chemical weapons if they begin to lose on the battlefield to Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Are you worried about nuclear war, the possibility of nuclear war?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I think it's necessary to pay attention to that possibility. That possibility existed before the February 2022 full blown invasion of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The doomsday arsenal that Russia possesses is enough to destroy the world many times over. And that's been the case every year since the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so of course we're concerned about that. We do know, however, that they have a system known as dual key. Dual key for their strategic nuclear weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Strategic nuclear weapons means the ones fired from silos, the missiles, the ones delivered from bombers or the ones fired from submarines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they're ready to go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're intercontinental. We watch that very, very closely. We watch all the movement of that and the alerts, etc.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We have tremendously, let's say, tremendous inside intelligence on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But dual key means that President Putin alone cannot fire them. He has one key, which he must insert.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He must then insert the codes for a command to launch. That then goes to the head of the general staff, who must has his own key and separate codes and must do the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Insert that key and codes for them to launch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so will the general staff chief go along with the destruction of the world over a battlefield loss in Ukraine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I don't know the answer to that and I don't know if anybody knows the answer to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Will those people flying those bombers, if they get the order from, if the dual key system goes into action and both keys are used and all the codes are implemented,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: will those young guys flying those bombers let those bombs go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Will those at the missile silos decide to engage and fire?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We don't know, but you can see that it's more than one man making the decision here in a system of strategic nuclear weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: As far as the tactical, the so-called low yield or battlefield nuclear weapons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: we're not sure the system that they have in Russia these days for their use of such tactical nuclear weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It could well be that Putin and just himself, he alone can fire them or order them be fired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What you know, Lex, there's no tactical nuclear weapon fired at Ukraine that's not also fired simultaneously at Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: If the Kremlin is 600 miles from Ukraine and if the wind changes direction or the wind happens to be blowing east, northeast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: the fallout hits your Kremlin, not just Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Moreover, you have all those border regions which are staging regions for the Russian offensive and they're a lot closer than 600 miles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're actually right there. So you fire that weapon on Ukrainian territory and you can get the fallout,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: just like the Chernobyl fallout spread to Sweden, which is how we got the Kremlin to finally, first they denied this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They said, oh, we don't know why there's a big nuclear cloud over Sweden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We don't know where that came from, but eventually they admitted it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So Russia can actually use a nuclear weapon, tactical battlefield one in Ukraine, without also firing it at itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And in addition, it's that same dynamic I alluded to earlier, which is to say you bomb a hospital, you bomb a school,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: there's more heavy weapons going to Ukraine from the west.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You can't get away with any of the, there's always going to be a response that's either proportional or greater than proportional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You could well have Europe signing on to NATO direct engagement, both Washington and Brussels,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: direct engagement of the Russian army on the territory of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You think that's possible to do that without dramatic escalation from the Russian side?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Yes, I do think it's possible, but it's very worrisome, just like you're saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But if Putin were to escalate like that, he's firing that weapon at himself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and he's potentially provoking a direct clash with NATO's military, not just with the Ukrainian military.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: If you're sitting in the Kremlin looking at those chart slacks of NATO capabilities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you can't conquer Ukraine, which didn't really have heavy weapons before February 2022 at scale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you're thinking, okay, now I'm going to take out NATO, that would be a bold step on the part of a Russian leader.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And let's also remember, Lex, that there's another variable here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You're a despot as long as everyone implements your orders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so if people start to say quietly, not necessarily publicly, I may not implement that order,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because that's maybe a criminal order, or my grandma is Ukrainian, or my wife is Ukrainian, or I don't want to go to the hog.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I don't want to spend the rest of my life in the hog, or whatever it might be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: At any point along the chain of command, from the general staff all the way down to the platoon,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: you're a despot provided they implement your orders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But who's to say that somewhere along the chain of command, people start to say, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I'm going to ignore that order, or I'm going to sabotage that order, or I'm going to flee the battlefield,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or I'm going to injure myself so that I don't have to fight, or I'm going to join the Ukrainian side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so it could be that what's left of the Russian army in the field begins to disintegrate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Even if the Ukrainians are not able to mount that counteroffensive at scale, that combined arms operation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: the Russian military in the field, which has taken horrendous casualties as far as we understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: something like a third of the original force, so you're talking about 50 to 60,000,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that includes both dead and wounded to the point of being unable to return to the battlefield.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Those are big numbers, those were a lot of families, a lot of families affected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Their sons, or their husbands, or their fathers are either missing in action,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or the regime won't tell them that they're dead, as you know from the sinking of that flagship,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Moskva, right, by the Ukrainians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so a disintegration of the Russian military, because there are orders that they either can't implement

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or don't want to implement, is also not excluded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so you have these two big variables, the Ukrainian army in the field and its ability to move from defense to offense at scale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and we're going to test that soon, and then the Russian ability in the field to hold together

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: in a war of conquest and aggression, where their conscripts, or their fed dog food,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or they don't have any weapons anymore because there's no resupply,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and so the disintegration of the army can't be excluded, and then of course all bets are off on the Putin regime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: More long-term, there are these technology export controls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We were talking about how the military-industrial complex in Russia is dependent on foreign component parts and software.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so if you have export controls, and you have firms voluntarily, even when they don't follow their export controls,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: leaving Russian business, refusing to do business with Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and we see this not just in the civilian sector like with McDonald's or many other companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: we see this in the key areas like the oil industry with the executives fleeing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that is the Western executives fleeing, giving up their positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So Russia's ability to resupply its tanks, resupply its missiles, resupply its uniforms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: resupply its food to its soldiers in the field and in their boots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We see a lot of stuff under tremendous stress, and in the long-term there's no obvious way

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: they can rebuild the military-industrial complex to produce those weapons

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because they're reliant on foreign parts that they can't get anymore,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and there are no domestic substitutes on the immediate horizon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's at the earliest a two-year proposition to have domestic substitutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And for some things like microelectronics, they've never had domestic substitutes

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: going back to the Soviet times, as you know well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so there's that pressure on Russia from the technology export controls,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: which if you're in the security ministry or the defense ministry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: if you're in that side of the regime, you're feeling that pain as we speak,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you're wondering about the strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Let me ask you about, again, the echoes of history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and it frustrates me in part when people draw these parallels,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but maybe there is some deep insight about those parallels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So there's a song that goes
