metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: 22.06.2014 Kiev was bombed, we were told that war had begun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So in Operation Barbarossa, the bombing of Kiev by Hitler,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: there is sort of an eerie parallel,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you have to be extremely careful drawing such parallels

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and such connections to this unexplainable war that is World War II.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But is there elements of this that do echo in the actions of Vladimir Putin?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And more specifically, do you think that Vladimir Putin is a war criminal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Can that label be assigned to the actions of this man?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The war criminal is a legal determination,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and it requires evidence and due process and the ability to defend oneself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We don't just decide in the Twittersphere or on a podcast that somebody is a war criminal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They can be a suspected war criminal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and we can gather evidence to try to prosecute that case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And then the issue for us Lexes, which court does it go to?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What's the appropriate place?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Does it happen in Ukraine because they're the victims?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Does it happen in the Hague because there's an international criminal court there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Does it happen inside Russia because there's regime change at some point?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And some of these people become, let's say, they get arrested by their own people inside Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So those are all important questions that have to be pursued with resources and with determination

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and by skilled people who are excellent at gathering that evidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And that process is underway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And Ukraine has a trial underway now of one alleged war criminal who's pleaded guilty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And we'll see what the outcome of that trial inside Ukraine is of a lower level official,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: not obviously Vladimir Putin, but the commander of a tank group.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So, yes, the names are eerily familiar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Izum, Kharkiv, Kiev, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Those are the names we know from the Nazi invasion and the Nazi occupation of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it's very deeply troubling to think that this could happen again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And there's a bizarre sense that the Russians claiming, as Putin says, to denazify Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: have invaded the same places that the Nazis invaded back in 1941.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: As somebody who's working on volume three of your work on Stalin going through this period, is it eerie to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Yes, it is, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I've written the chapters of volume three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I've drafted the chapters on the war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And as I said, the place names are very evocative, unfortunately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But, you know, the Nazis failed ultimately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They captured Ukraine for a time, but they were evicted from Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And there was massive partisan or guerrilla warfare resistance behind Nazi lines the whole time

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that they were allegedly in control of Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: If you look at the maps on cable TV, they show you the sign of Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They show you the coloring, Russian control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they draw a line and then it's colored in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But the word control is misplaced.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They don't actually control it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's Russian claimed or extent of farthest Russian troop advancement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Because behind the Russian lines in Ukraine, Crimea accepted, you have insurgencies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You have armed insurgency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: In Melitopol, for example, which is a place that you know in southeastern Ukraine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: there is a guerrilla war now underway to hurt the Russians who are in occupation of that city and region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And we're going to see that continue, even if the war becomes a stalemate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: even if it's stalemates more or less at the lines we're at now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: which would mean that anticipated Ukrainian counteroffensive at scale proves unsuccessful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The Russian army doesn't disintegrate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you end up with a stalemate where there could be a ceasefire or not a ceasefire,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but neither side is attempting an offensive for the time being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There will be resistance behind those Russian lines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it will be fierce resistance, the kind of resistance we saw to the Nazi occupation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Ultimately, it took the Red Army reinvading the territory of Ukraine

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and succeeding at combined arms operations at scale,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: a massive counteroffensive much larger than anything we're talking about today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Ultimately, it required that to evict the Nazis from Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But in the meantime, they did not have an easy occupation regime there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Ukrainian partisans, Soviet partisans killed Nazi officials, Wehrmacht soldiers, Wehrmacht officers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: blew up the infrastructure they were using, made them pay a price for their occupation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We could well see, if unfortunately this ends in a stalemate for the time being,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: we could well see that type of insurgency gain momentum behind Russian lines

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and try to evict the Russians that way

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and then remount the counteroffensive at scale later on in the future if the first one doesn't succeed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So that would be further echoes of the World War II experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The scale, once again, is much smaller.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The size of the armies here, they're not in the many hundreds, 800,000, 700,000, a million two, a million four.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's not what we're talking about today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But the weapons, the cruise missiles, right, artillery fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You know, artillery fire used to be very inaccurate and it was like saturation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You would just fire towards the enemy lines and if you hit something, you hit something, and if you didn't, you just kept firing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Now you have drones, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so artillery fire is now sniper fire because you can coordinate the direction of the artillery fire with the drones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The drones can take a picture and show you where the enemy is precisely located

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you can align that artillery to hit them instead of just indiscriminately bombing an area, a territory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And the NATO supplied artillery goes really far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you can fire into Russian positions and yourself not be exposed to Russian fire

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because your artillery fires farther than theirs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So that's coming and we're going to see that in action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so the scale is not the same, but the weapons, the precision of some of the weapons and some of the NATO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We're not sending all of our stuff, but as I said, the dynamic is Russia commits atrocities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Russia bombs schools, Russia bombs hospitals, Russia kills civilians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and more and heavier and more lethal Western weapons go to Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Their willingness to risk their lives is really so impressive and the reason that we, it's our duty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We're obliged to supply those weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so the Russians don't have that resupply and the Ukrainians do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so the Russians are now digging in, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're digging in deeply in the areas that they've penetrated

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and they're trying to build unassailable positions for when the Ukrainians transition

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: from mostly defense to full scale offense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And we'll see if that now, I mean, they're digging everywhere, you know, as they say, kapayut, kapayut, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're digging everywhere behind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The Russian is beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But so there are these things that we can't predict,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but there are these things we're watching and watching closely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And on top of that, something that's not in World War II or for the most part is cyber attacks and cyber warfare,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: is much less perhaps convertible into human words because it happens so quickly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: it's such large scales, so difficult to trace and all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's not bullets, it's electrical signals and that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Yeah, but those Ukrainian people, they're like you, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're young and they're technically really proficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they've been amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You know, they spent those teenage years in the basement playing video games.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Turns out it's useful after all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It turns out it's more than useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You can save your country that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so they're not alone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're getting support and that support is important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But really, predominantly, it's Ukrainians on the cyber battlefield

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and their skills have been very impressive and they've been preparing for this for a number of years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And they have a whole army of young people on the cyber side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's their civilian population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: These are not people conscripted into the military or volunteering wearing the uniform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so even in cyber warfare, the Ukrainians have been extremely impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so let's remember that all of these aspects of warfare,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: whether it's how far your cruise missiles go and how accurate they are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: what size your cyber capabilities are, it's really ultimately about the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's about the human capital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's about their willingness, their skill level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but also their willingness to fight and to put their lives on the line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And there's no substitute for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so what's called morale or courage or bravery or valor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that's really the ultimately decisive provided you have enough sufficient arms to conduct the fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And if you don't, you use a Molotov cocktail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Grandma calls in the coordinates of the Russian tank on her iPhone

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you have a Molotov cocktail that the people who used to work in the cafeteria

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: are now stuffing flammable liquid into bottles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you carry one right up to the tank and you smash it against the tank

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or you drop it in one of the hatches in the tank.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There's no substitute for that kind of stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that level of resolve, willingness to die for your country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's a really big lesson that we need to absorb in our own country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We've been going to war more frequently than we should.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And like you said, without the justification all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And then like Henry Kissinger said, without understanding how this was going to end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's easy to start a war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's very difficult to win a war, prevail in a war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or end a war on terms that meet your original expectations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We've been fighting wars, but we haven't been fighting wars as societies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We've been fighting wars as a small sliver of our population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Something like 1% of our population is involved with the military

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because we have an all-volunteer force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And that means that it's easier for our politicians to go to war

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because they don't face conscription.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They don't have the draft, which affects every family in the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And because the number of people in the volunteer force

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: is such a narrow stratum of the population.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so they've been getting away with this

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because the professional army is much better than the conscript army.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And an all-volunteer force is much preferable from a military point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But from a societal point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: it enables you to go to war too easily as a politician.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it doesn't engage the society the same way that the Ukrainian society

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: is completely engaged from those young hackers all the way up to those grandmothers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Let me ask you, you're a scholar of history, a scholar of geopolitics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and you're also a human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's kind of you, Lex. I'll take that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What's the value, what's the hope, what's the power of conversation here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: If you could sit down with Vladimir Putin and have a conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: versus bullets, human exchange words,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: is there hope for those?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And if so, what would you talk about? What would you ask him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And President Biden, the previous presidents, secretaries of state,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: officials below secretary of state, the head of the CIA,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: on the border before he invaded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And we sent the head of the CIA and Putin received him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: somebody he evidently respects or was at least willing to meet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: unlike other members of the administration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So a lot of people are talking to him in some form or another

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: for the 22 years he's been in power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And I'm not sure it's had what I would call their desired effect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Well, the nature of the conversation is interesting too,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and also the timing, which is post-February 22nd, is a different time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And also another aspect, which Oliver Stone mentioned interestingly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that there is something about COVID and the pandemic that creates isolation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: the distancing. It's such a silly little nuanced thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but maybe it actually has a profound impact on the human being,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: the human mind of Vladimir Putin, that there is something about an in-person meeting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and not across a table that's far too large,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but sort of the intimacy of a one human to human in-person conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that there's something distinctly powerful about that reminder

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that as Putin says in the narrative and the propaganda,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that we're all one people. There is truth to that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that this entirety of humanity is one people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you're kind of reminded by that when you're sitting together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: People who have sat across the table from him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: whether at 30 yards or at three, have remarked upon this feeling of isolation

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that has affected him, the pandemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I think there must be something to that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: if several people who've been in the room with him are remarking on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Everybody that I know and I've been able to talk to who's had a meeting with him

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: in the past 10 years, including Henry Kissinger, the former Secretary of State,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: has said that Putin spends a lot of time enumerating his grievances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and then the West cheated us on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so it's not the conversation that you're encouraging of common humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's that roiling resentment volcano that's just exploding and exploding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's the resentment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And by the time he gets through the monologue of the grievances,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: the time of the meeting is expired or over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's a brilliant statement, but that's where the skill of conversation comes in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Like when you're facing a bull with a red cloth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: you have to learn how to avoid the long list of grievances and get to the humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: That's a really important skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's a skill. For sure it's a skill,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and it's the highest level skill of a diplomat to be able to reach some type of common understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: when interests and worldviews clash so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But here's your challenge, Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Your challenge is Russia wants to impose a closed sphere of influence on its neighbors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It wants to dictate what its neighbors can and can't do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It wants to exert influence not by the power of its example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: not by the freedom of its people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: not by the dynamism of its diversified economy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but it wants to exert influence just because it deserves that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: just because it's a great power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: just because and on and on and on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's a civilization unto itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it wants that, and we can't give that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The reason that Russia was not integrated into the West was not for lack of trying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It was because Russia ultimately spurned the integration

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because it was about what terms the integration would come on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Would you come into the West and observe Western rules

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: and be another country, meaning just another country?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There's Poland and there's Austria and there's little tiny Monaco and there's Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you're just one of those countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And Russia's answer to that was no, we're not just one of those countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We need special rules. We need special conditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We'll integrate, but only as a special country,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: meaning like at the UN where all countries are sovereign,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: all countries are members, but Russia has a veto on what countries can and can't do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Those were the terms on which they were willing to integrate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And those were the terms that no leader of a Western country

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But once again, the problem there, Alex, is Putin is surrounded by this cocoon known as the FSO.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: He meets on Zoom predominantly with the rest of the government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: including with the defense and security officials.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They don't have frequent access to his person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And as you were alluding earlier to the pandemic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: they have to quarantine for two weeks before every meeting with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And moreover, you know, Alex, they don't know where he is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You see, when they're on Zoom with him and the room, it's the Valdai.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: His office in the Valdai region looks the same as his office in Sochi

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or his office outside of Moscow and Novgorod.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: They're made up to look very similar on Zoom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And sure, some signs they're looking, where is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But maybe they don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And so you're going to move on him and you're going to jump him in his Kremlin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: his dacha outside Moscow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it turns out he's in Sochi or vice versa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it turns out the FSO is loyal to him and won't let you anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So, Lex, we don't know, but we watch this FSO really closely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And we think that the elites, if not Putin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: that they could play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And one last question, the biggest question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You studied some of the darkest aspects of human history, human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Let me ask the why question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What are we doing here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What's the meaning of our existence, our life here on earth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: What are we humans trying to get at here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: I can't answer that question either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But I can say that having a purposeful life is actually not that hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You can't, you're not Gandhi.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You're not President Roosevelt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You're not going to transform a country or a civilization or become immortal

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: because of your courage and your insight and your genius at critical moments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But you live in an environment, you're in a school, you're in a workplace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You're somewhere where you can affect other people in a positive way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It can be not just about yourself, but it can be about them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you can have a positive impact on other people's lives through the work that you do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: whether that's your employment or your charity or your spare time or your work time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It can be by modeling proper behavior, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Admitting your mistakes, hard to do but necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Remembering that you don't know everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: You can't predict the future, but you don't even know everything in your areas of expertise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Painfully reminded of that humility at times, but remind yourself too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: So you can lead a life that can show others what good values are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you can lead a life that dedicates yourself not only to your own material well-being,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: but to the well-being and to the development of others around you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And it can be on a humble scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It can be in a small classroom or a small workplace, a small work team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But it can be done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And you can be reminded that having a positive impact even on one other person

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: gives far greater meaning to your own life and is profoundly satisfying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: much more satisfying than the attention you might get, let's say, on social media

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: or awards you might receive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: There's nothing wrong with pursuing those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: People pursue them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: It's a free society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: But leading a purposeful life intentionally is possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Even just one person, I love the expression, save one life, save the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Just focusing on the local, on the tiny little difference you can make in the world can somehow ripple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: If you think about that every single day, you're a better person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: We're a better society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: And maybe you get to add a bit of love to the world after all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Stephen, this is a huge honor for many reasons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Thank you so much for doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: Thank you for not just talking today, but giving me so much respect

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Kotkin: Putin, Stalin, Hitler, Zelenskyy, and War in Ukraine | Lex Fridman Podcast #289

body.input: The following is a conversation with Vladimir Vapnik.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: He's the co-inventor of the support vector machines, support vector clustering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: VC theory, and many foundational ideas in statistical learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: He was born in the Soviet Union and worked at the Institute of Control Sciences in Moscow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Then, in the United States, he worked at AT&T, NEC Labs, Facebook Research,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: and now is a professor at Columbia University.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: His work has been cited over 170,000 times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: He has some very interesting ideas about artificial intelligence and the nature of learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: especially on the limits of our current approaches and the open problems in the field.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: This conversation is part of an MIT course on artificial general intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: and the artificial intelligence podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: If you enjoy it, please subscribe on YouTube or rate it on iTunes or your podcast provider of choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Or simply connect with me on Twitter or other social networks at Lex Friedman, spelled F-R-I-D.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: And now, here's my conversation with Vladimir Vapnik.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Einstein famously said that God doesn't play dice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: You have studied the world through the eyes of statistics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: so let me ask you in terms of the nature of reality, fundamental nature of reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: does God play dice?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: We don't know some factors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: And because we don't know some factors, which could be important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: it looks like God plays dice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: But we should describe it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: In philosophy, they distinguish between two positions, positions of instrumentalism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: where you're creating theory for prediction and position of realism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: where you're trying to understand what God did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Can you describe instrumentalism and realism a little bit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: For example, if you have some mechanical laws, what is that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Is it law which is true always and everywhere?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: Or it is law which allows you to predict the position of a moving element?

metadata.title: Podcast: Vladimir Vapnik: Statistical Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #5

body.input: What you believe?

body.input: Are there a lot of positive thoughts, negative thoughts, demons, inspirational things, maybe no thoughts at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: Yeah, that's the really interesting part of the sport, I think, because you can essentially what it is when we're looking at like the hundred mile distance or anything that's like all day long is you're going to have the full run of the day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: You're going to have the full range of the full spectrum of emotions, of mental processes, both kind of positive, negative and in between.

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: And I think that's just a weird mental process to reflect upon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: And that's what kind of draws people back to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: And if you let it keep going, it keeps going all the way to like, why am I here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: make sure you get it done, even if it means like, you know, death marching is what they'll call it in the ultrarunning community, the end of the race.

metadata.title: Podcast: Zach Bitter: Ultramarathon Running | Lex Fridman Podcast #205

body.input: Just to say like, you got that full experience, you experienced the highs, the lows, the full thing, the starting, the crossing the finish line, that release of emotion when you're done and all that stuff.
